title: Savage Hunters

== History ==
The Savage Hunters (SH) was a prominent Quake team from Brazil from the late 90s and early 2000s. Some original players included Tito, [[Lalo]], [[Pegaso]], [[Ratosh]], [[Supreme]] and [[Fateful]]. SH later became an important part of the foundation of [[Try Again]].

The team returned in 2024, but ultimately disbanded again.
